title: Closure review — T10 (retrospective, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Closure review — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Outcome vs acceptance

T10's section 12 gate asks that PI planning materialise cards from the backlog by WSJF within WIP; that a deliverable without evidence cannot demo; that a retro produce lessons; that an end-of-tranche review with no baselines, benefit status or risk evidence be refused; and that a transition which never measured its baseline cannot report the benefit realized. Materialisation, the demo gate, retro lessons and the benefit baseline gate hold and were re-read for this review. The tranche-review clause is refused without evidence as written, but the evidence bar is presence-only (v1-p83-1) and the baseline requirement is not gated (v1-p83-4); both are carried as named deviations. The level is compliant with named deviations.

## Evidence

- `acceptance/programme/T10.toml` — the project's manifest.
- `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs` (lines 179, 215, 249, 302, 386); `crates/store/tests/refinement.rs` (lines 114, 152); `crates/store/tests/demo_gate.rs` (line 94); `crates/store/tests/retro.rs` (lines 156, 190); `crates/store/tests/tranche_review.rs` (line 208); `crates/store/tests/benefit_transition.rs` (lines 161, 194); `crates/actions/tests/pi_plan_approval.rs` (lines 249, 274, 297, 338, 363); `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs` (line 153).
- `migrations/0056_cadence_tranche.sql` and `migrations/0044_plan_spine.sql`.
- the 2026-11-22 project row in `/tmp/u7-snapshot/data/programme.json` — `closed`, version 11, tranche 4.

## Open items

- `v1-p83-1` (P1) — tranche authorisation and review evidence are presence-only. Owned by T10.
- `v1-p83-2` (P1) — benefit measurement has no typed baseline/post values. Owned by T10.
- `v1-p83-3` (P1) — BCM and benefit ownership are free text. Owned by T10.
- `v1-p83-4` (P1) — tranche baselines are nullable and unapproved. Owned by T10.
- `v1-p83-5` (P1) — `programmes.update` closes without a review or plan. Owned by T10.
- `v1-p83-6` (P2) — PMP closure reads only the scope baseline.
- `v1-p82-5` (P2) — the PI backlog is one project's WBS.
- `v1-p82-6` (P2) — lessons need no evidence and emit no kata candidates.

None is waived.

## Decision

Retain the register's `closed` status on the P0-only product gate. Requested by the programme's service actor `conveyor-e2e` and decided by the distinct approver `conveyor-approver` under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`; the requester is not the approver. The eight open items are carried into the next tranche and must be disposed by a dated decision at the programme's viability review if still open.
